questions.question: How many continents do most English-speaking countries recognize?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that most English-speaking countries recognize seven continents.
Incorrect. Four continents is mentioned as one possible variation, but not the number recognized by most English-speaking countries.
Incorrect. Five continents is not the number recognized by most English-speaking countries according to the article.
Incorrect. Six continents is mentioned as a model used in some regions, but not by most English-speaking countries.

questions.question: Which continent is listed as the largest in area in the seven-continent model?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article lists Asia first among the seven continents in order from largest to smallest in area.
Incorrect. Africa is listed second, not first, in the order from largest to smallest.
Incorrect. North America is listed third, not first, in the order from largest to smallest.
Incorrect. Europe is listed sixth, not first, in the order from largest to smallest.

questions.question: Which two continents are joined by the Isthmus of Suez?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Africa and Asia are joined by the Isthmus of Suez.
Incorrect. North America and South America are joined by the Isthmus of Panama, not the Isthmus of Suez.
Incorrect. Europe and Asia form Eurasia, but they are not joined by the Isthmus of Suez.
Incorrect. Australia and Antarctica are not joined by the Isthmus of Suez.

questions.question: Which two continents are joined by the Isthmus of Panama?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that North America and South America are joined by the Isthmus of Panama.
Incorrect. Africa and Asia are joined by the Isthmus of Suez, not the Isthmus of Panama.
Incorrect. Europe and Asia are not joined by the Isthmus of Panama.
Incorrect. Australia and Antarctica are not joined by the Isthmus of Panama.

questions.question: Which of the seven most globally recognized continents are completely separated from other continents by the ocean?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that of the seven most globally recognized continents, only Antarctica and Australia are completely separated from other continents by the ocean.
Incorrect. Africa and Asia are joined by the Isthmus of Suez.
Incorrect. North America and South America are joined by the Isthmus of Panama.
Incorrect. Europe and Asia are part of the continuous landmass of Eurasia.

questions.question: Which continent is deemed the smallest continent according to the article?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Australia, at 7,617,930 square kilometres, is deemed the smallest continent.
Incorrect. Greenland is considered the world's largest island, not the smallest continent.
Incorrect. Europe is not identified as the smallest continent in the article.
Incorrect. Antarctica is not identified as the smallest continent in the article.

questions.question: Which supercontinent did the current continents form from breaking up, according to the idea of continental drift?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that continental drift postulates that the current continents formed from the breaking up of a supercontinent called Pangaea.
Incorrect. Eurasia is a landmass combining Europe and Asia, not the supercontinent mentioned.
Incorrect. Afro-Eurasia is a combined landmass, not the supercontinent Pangaea.
Incorrect. Gondwana is not mentioned in the article as the supercontinent from which current continents formed.

questions.question: Which model of continents is taught in most English-speaking countries including Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that the seven-continent model is taught in most English-speaking countries including Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
Incorrect. The six-continent combined-America model is taught in Greece and many Romance-speaking countries, not most English-speaking countries.
Incorrect. The six-continent combined-Eurasia model is mostly used in Russia and some parts of Eastern Europe.
Incorrect. The four-continent model is not described as being taught in most English-speaking countries.

questions.question: Which continent is defined as a great quantity of land not separated by any sea from the rest of the world, according to Peter Heylin's 17th century writing?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article quotes Peter Heylin writing that 'A Continent is a great quantity of Land, not separated by any Sea from the rest of the World, as the whole Continent of Europe, Asia, Africa.'
Incorrect. North America is not mentioned in Peter Heylin's definition in the article.
Incorrect. Australia is not mentioned in Peter Heylin's definition in the article.
Incorrect. Antarctica is not mentioned in Peter Heylin's definition in the article.

questions.question: Which continent is excluded from the five rings of the Olympic flag?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that the Olympic flag's five rings represent the five inhabited continents of the combined-America model but exclude the uninhabited Antarctica.
Incorrect. Asia is one of the inhabited continents represented by the Olympic rings.
Incorrect. Europe is one of the inhabited continents represented by the Olympic rings.
Incorrect. Africa is one of the inhabited continents represented by the Olympic rings.
